o.text:
PIE word
 *kʷetwóres
Borrowed from Russian кварта́л (kvartál), from German Quartal, Latin quartalis.
From Proto-Common Turkic *tezek, from Proto-Turkic *teŕ-. Cognate with Chuvash тирӗс (tirĕs), etc.
From Persian جنایتکار (jenâyatkâr). By surface analysis, cinayət + -kar.
From Arabic حَقِيبَة (ḥaqība). Compare Ottoman Turkish هگبه (heğbe).
A derivation of *büt- (“to end, accomplish; to create, build; to heal; to grow, ripen”), whence also Azerbaijani bütün (“all”) and Azerbaijani bütöv (“entire, whole”).
